## What you need

ANTH418 uses three main tools:

- **R** — the statistical computing language;
- **RStudio Desktop** — the environment in which we organize and run most R work;
- **Quarto** — the publishing system that combines prose, code, results, figures, tables, and citations.

You will also use the **tidyverse**, a collection of R packages for importing, transforming, summarizing, and visualizing data.

## Step 1 — Install R

Download R from the Comprehensive R Archive Network:

<https://cran.r-project.org/>

Choose the installer for your operating system and use the standard installation options.

## Step 2 — Install RStudio Desktop

Download the free RStudio Desktop:

<https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/>

Install the current stable release.

::: {.callout-note title="R must be installed before RStudio"}
RStudio provides an interface for working with R, but it does not replace R itself.
:::

## Step 3 — Check Quarto

Open RStudio and select the **Terminal** tab.

Run:

```bash
quarto --version
